name: Haldi Adrak Shot
subtitle: turmeric and ginger with the black pepper that makes it work

ingredients.note: 2 tsp ground will do; the colour stains everything it meets

steps.text: Blend the turmeric, ginger and 80ml water to a slurry.
Strain hard through a fine sieve or a muslin. Squeeze the pulp dry; most of the yield is in the last press.
Stir in the lemon juice, black pepper and honey.
Divide into two small glasses and drink.

storage: Keeps three days in a sealed jar in the fridge. Shake before pouring; it separates.

provenance.note: The pepper is doing real work rather than seasoning. Curcumin on its own is poorly absorbed, and piperine from black pepper raises that absorption by a wide margin, which is why the two have been cooked together in Indian kitchens for as long as anyone has written recipes down.
